about_the_game:
Zombie Kebab is a fast VR action game set during a zombie apocalypse. You run a small kebab stand and try to survive each night by cooking food, fighting off zombies, and searching for new ingredients.

Cook kebabs for the few humans still hiding in the city. Prepare orders quickly, keep your grill running, and manage limited supplies. The faster you cook, the more money and upgrades you earn.

When the horde attacks, switch from cooking to combat. Use frying pans, knives, and improvised weapons to defend your food truck.

Unlock new tools and guns to survive longer waves.

Between shifts, explore the city in search of ingredients and materials. What you find affects what you can cook the next night.

Zombie Kebab combines fast cooking gameplay with first-person VR action. Quick decisions, chaos, and dark humor make it feel like working at a real 4 a.m. food stand — just with more zombies.

FEATURES

  • VR cooking and combat gameplay

  • Wave defense core loop

  • Playable district (city center)

  • Realistic motion-based cooking interactions

  • Physical melee and throwing combat

  • 10+ weapons and tools

  • Ingredient scavenging between waves

  • Food management system

  • Score-based progression

  • Dynamic audio and environmental sound

  • Semi-realistic, dirty neon visual style

  • Endless replayable structure Local high-score system Optimized for VR arcade sessions (10–30 min survival runs)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300 HQ equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index, WMR headsets, and Meta Quest 2
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index, WMR headsets, and Meta Quest 2

short_description: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”
